Description: I was born in 1982 in Istanbul. I started my university life in 1999 at Istanbul University, Department of Foreign Trade. During my time as a diving instructor, I had the chance to reach more people by publishing a series of training videos on youtube and other social media platforms. During this period, I worked in the field of video editing-post-production at a professional level. As of January 2022, I started working in a team at Keller Williams Platinum Regional Directorate.
